overview_description.description:
Skillful AI is a technology platform that focuses on identifying, developing, and matching artificial intelligence talent with organisations that require AI expertise. The platform provides tools to assess technical skills, evaluate competencies, and connect qualified professionals with companies seeking AI-related capabilities.

Skillful AI offers services that help organisations manage AI talent pipelines, evaluate candidate proficiency, and support workforce development in areas such as machine learning, data science, and automation technologies. The platform is designed to support recruitment, skill verification, and talent development processes.

product.name: Skillful AI Platform
product.description: A platform for creating, deploying, and managing personalized AI assistants with memory-driven personalization and data privacy features.

product.name: Skillful AI Marketplace
product.description: A blockchain-powered marketplace for buying, selling, and trading AI skills and personalized AI assistants as unique digital assets.

product.name: AI Development Tools
product.description: Tools and interfaces that enable users to build custom AI models and modular AI assistants without requiring technical expertise.

product.name: Skillful AI App
product.description: An application for designing, personalizing, and deploying AI assistants with blockchain-backed security and advanced memory features.
